description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for git's diff and textconv functionalities. It defines a series of tests to verify the behavior of git diff, show, log, and other commands with respect to binary and text files, textconv filters, and symlinks. The script sets up test data, runs commands, and compares their output to expected results.

methods.name: find_diff
methods.description: A helper function that filters diff output to remove headers and footers, extracting only relevant diff details.
